Avocado Glow Nourishing Skin Cream is a comforting avocado face cream for daily moisturising care. The 10g formula is designed to help support soft-looking, smooth and comfortably nourished skin, with a rich yet easy-to-layer finish. Use this avocado-enriched skincare essential when your routine calls for a simple facial moisturiser that feels considered rather than complicated.

Key ingredients: avocado, aloe vera, vitamin B3 and kojic acid. Because the cream contains kojic acid, wear sunscreen whenever you use it in the daytime.

Avocado Face Cream Benefits

This nourishing face cream is formulated for a comfortable skin feel and a soft, polished-looking finish. It fits naturally into a morning or evening ritual, whether you prefer a minimal routine or like to layer your skincare thoughtfully.

  • Helps provide moisturising care for soft, smooth-feeling skin
  • Supports a fresh, radiant-looking appearance without making treatment claims
  • Works as an avocado moisturiser for everyday facial care
  • Leaves a nourishing finish that can sit comfortably beneath daytime sunscreen
  • Comes in a convenient 10g size for travel, trial or on-the-go routines

Avocado-Enriched Skincare

This avocado cream for face is centred on a nourishing avocado skincare experience. Avocado is valued in skincare for its rich, comforting character, making it a natural fit for a daily face cream focused on moisture and softness. The formula is intended for cosmetic care and is not a treatment for skin conditions.

For the complete and most current ingredient list, always refer to the product packaging. You can also explore Mirc Glow’s approach on the Ingredients page. For general consumer information on cosmetic ingredients, the U.S. Food & Drug Administration’s cosmetic ingredient guidance is a useful reference.

How to Use This Avocado Face Cream

Use a small amount as the moisturising step in your daily skincare routine. The texture is designed to be easy to work into a simple routine.

  1. Cleanse and gently pat the face and neck dry.
  2. Take a small amount of cream with clean fingertips.
  3. Massage over the face and neck using gentle upward, outward motions.
  4. In the morning, follow with sunscreen; in the evening, use as the final moisturising step.

Start with a small amount and adjust to your preferred finish. If you are introducing a new cosmetic product, patch test first and discontinue use if irritation occurs.

Using this avocado face cream under sunscreen

This is the lightest cream in our range, which makes it the one to use in the daytime. A simple morning routine looks like this.

  1. Rinse your face or cleanse lightly.
  2. Apply a small amount of Avocado Glow Nourishing Skin Cream.
  3. Wait a minute for it to settle.
  4. Apply sunscreen.

In humid weather, a very thin layer is enough. In winter or in air-conditioned rooms, you can use a little more.

A trial and travel size

At 10g, this jar is small on purpose. It lets you find out how your skin likes avocado care before you buy a larger cream, and it fits in a handbag, a gym bag or a travel pouch. Used once a day, it lasts around two to three weeks.

Which skin types does it suit?

Dry and normal skin. Use it morning and night.

Combination skin. Apply mainly to the cheeks.

Oily skin. Use a very small amount, and only where your skin feels tight.

Sensitive skin. Patch test behind the ear first.

Not sure which cream is right for you? Take the skin quiz.

Pair it with a night cream

For the evening, pair this avocado face cream with a richer night cream. The Avocado Night Cream with Kojic Acid is our most nourishing option, and the two are sold together in the Day and Night Cream Combo. If you want a more even-looking tone, the Avocado Korean Night Cream adds vitamin B3 and kojic acid.

Product FAQs

What is Avocado Glow Nourishing Skin Cream?

It is a 10g avocado face cream from Mirc Glow, formulated for nourishing, daily moisturising care and a soft-looking skin finish.

How do I use this avocado face cream?

Apply a small amount to clean, dry face and neck, then massage gently until absorbed. Use before sunscreen in the morning or as the final moisturising step at night.

Can I use it every day?

Yes, it is designed for daily cosmetic moisturising care. Patch test first when trying any new skincare product, particularly if your skin is sensitive.

Can men use this avocado face cream?

Yes. It is suitable for both women and men.

Can I wear it under make-up?

Yes. Apply a thin layer, let it settle for a minute, then continue with sunscreen and make-up.

Does it contain kojic acid?

Yes. Along with avocado, it contains aloe vera, vitamin B3 and kojic acid. Wear sunscreen in the daytime, and check the pack for the full ingredient list.

How to use it as a morning cream: read our avocado day cream guide.
